name: Moritz Beutter
headline: Global AI, Apps & Agents Business Strategy Lead at Microsoft I xMcK I CDTM
summary:
Technical AI GTM leader operating at the intersection of product, field, and enterprise transformation. I design and scale repeatable motions that help organizations move from AI experimentation to production impact- combining technical depth, commercial judgment, and cross-functional leadership.
 
At Microsoft, I lead global go-to-market strategy for AI, apps, and agents on Azure—enabling ~100k enterprise customers and ~20k sellers, and influencing $xM+ in AI-related pipeline. My focus is turning emerging AI capabilities into scalable, field-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
 
Previously, I was an Engagement Manager at McKinsey Digital, leading large-scale transformations across advanced industries (manufacturing, semiconductors, automotive), with a strong focus on GenAI, data, and sales excellence.
 
Earlier in my career (2019), I founded and exited an NLP startup focused on knowledge management for media organizations. The company built on early transformer models such as GPT-2 and BERT, helping editorial teams structure and retrieve information more effectively.
 
What I care about:
a) Making AI real in enterprise environments (not just pilots) 
b) Building scalable platforms, not one-off solutions 
c) Bridging product innovation with GTM execution

I hold a Master’s degree in Management & Technology from the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and an Honors Degree from the Center for Digital Technology & Management (CDTM). My background allows me to combine technical depth with commercial thinking to translate complex technologies into tangible outcomes

company.name: Microsoft
company.description:
Every company has a mission. What's ours? To empower every person and every organization to achieve more. We believe technology can and should be a force for good and that meaningful innovation contributes to a brighter world in the future and today. Our culture doesn’t just encourage curiosity; it embraces it. Each day we make progress together by showing up as our authentic selves. We show up with a learn-it-all mentality. We show up cheering on others, knowing their success doesn't diminish our own. We show up every day open to learning our own biases, changing our behavior, and inviting in differences. Because impact matters.
